candidate.definition_en: To echo or resound repeatedly, or to have continuing and widespread effects.
candidate.explanation_ar: الصوت لما يتردد ويعمل صدى قوي، أو خبر ينتشر ويعمل ضجة.

senses.definition_en: To echo or resound repeatedly within an enclosed space.
senses.definition_ar: يتردد صداه أو يدوي في المكان بشكل متكرر.
examples: The loud organ music began to reverberate through the grand hall.

senses.definition_en: To have continuing and widespread repercussions or effects.
senses.definition_ar: تكون له أصداء وتأثيرات متتالية وواسعة النطاق.
examples: Her unexpected resignation will reverberate across the political landscape.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
The loud organ music began to reverberate through the grand hall.
Her unexpected resignation will reverberate across the political landscape.
The economic crash will reverberate for decades to come.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها جزء 'Vibrate' 'يهتز'.. الصوت لما يـ 'Reverberate' بيعمل اهتزاز وصدى في المكان.
